Thanks for the draft, Stephanie — this is excellent and close. A few edits/comments inline below and a final quote we’re comfortable using.

Inline notes:
- The 95th-percentile latency number should be listed as 35% reduction (measured across the fleet gateway-to-response time for edge inference). The 38% fleet median you list is an internal rolling metric — to avoid confusion, prefer the rounded 35% for public copy.
- Throughput: the 3x number is correct for the gateway aggregation case; add parenthetical that this is under our Q3 batching config.
- Per-job cost: we prefer a conservative public figure. Instead of "halved" can you change to "reduced by ~45%"? Our finance folks ran a sample that shows 42–48% depending on payload.

Final one-line quote (feel free to tweak punctuation):
"Redwood Inference cut our field inference latency by ~35% and reduced per-incident compute cost by ~45%. — Alex Lowe, Head of Field Ops, StratusNav"

Attaching a plain-text copy of the quote: customer-quote-a_lowe.txt

Also: please remove the sentence that mentions monthly token counts for the fleet — that’s not a customer-facing metric we track publicly.

Happy to sign off once wording is adjusted.

—Alex
